message.reasoning: We need to answer: "Is the invoice date the same as when we first signed up, or does it shift each month?" According to policy: monthly plan invoiced on same day of month as workspace's original billing date. That date does not shift month to month even though months have different lengths; a billing date of the 31st bills on the last day of a shorter month. So answer: invoice date stays same day each month, based on original billing date. Provide that.

function.arguments: {"message":"The invoice date stays the same each month – it’s the same day of the month as when your workspace first started or last renewed. Even if the month has fewer days (e.g. a 31st), the invoice will still be issued on that day (or the last day of the month)."}
